purpose: Scene artwork for the Daily Sib Treasure Chest group post (صندوقچه گنج روزانه).

usage.note: The group main-menu button posts this image as a photo with the Persian caption and the open button. A missing or failed upload falls back to the text message with the same caption and button.

technical.encoding: baseline jpeg, 4:2:0 subsampling, 8-bit RGB, no embedded ICC profile (sRGB assumed)

generation.tool: arena-agent image model (text-to-image with in-game scene style references)

scenes.description_en: One closed wooden treasure chest with honey-gold bands and a gold apple lock plate on a mossy stone path in an orchard, with a red and a green apple, scattered gold coins and a distant castle in the background. No characters and no text.
